aplicacao_citacao: Sec. 5.3 (p.9): 'Two different strength grades were adopted, namely, 40 MPa and 70 MPa, to cover all the aspects of concrete employed for various purposes. Concrete grade of 40 MPa ... most common type of concrete employed for structural purposes ... 70 MPa ... is employed in tall structures' - descricao generica das classes, sem aplicacao propria do estudo (revisao + calculo por 1 m3)
nota: Revisao com calculo de CO2 por 1 m3 (cradle-to-gate). Nenhum numero de anos de vida util no artigo; so mencoes qualitativas a lifespan (Sec. 3.2: 'a 50% enhancement in the lifespan of structural concrete in the United States would have led to a 14% decrease in total CO2-e' [49] - percentagem, nao vida util). Se se quiser forcar uma aplicacao, a frase sobre M70 aponta para 'tall structures' (edificio), mas e generica.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec. 2.6 (p.3): samples from Sodupe et al. [20] 'the feasibility of producing precast elements with rubber doped mortar' was evaluated; Sec. 4 (p.10): 'implementing these proportions of CR in bricks and blocks can lead to considerable energy savings in the building'
nota: Confirma o registo anterior: zero mencoes a anos de vida util. Sec. 3.3 so diz 'it is assumed that the evaluated mortars behavior will remain adequate throughout their lifetime'; ACV cradle-to-gate por 1 m3 de argamassa. A aplicacao vem da fonte das misturas (Sodupe et al., blocos/tijolos prefabricados) e da discussao; o artigo tambem diz que a argamassa e 'widely used ... in the construction of buildings'.

declarada.citacao: Sec. LCA/custo, Eq.(12) (p.13): 'X ... service life of the structure ... In the present investigation, the life period was assumed to be 50 years, therefore alpha can be taken as 2.9% [86]'

aplicacao_citacao: Sec. 5.1 (p.12): 'the needed service for columns made with composite materials used in buildings will be extremely low throughout the course of their design operational life'; estudo de colunas de HSGC sob fogo ISO 834 'fire safety is a crucial factor in the planning and design of buildings'
nota: Valor gravado (50 anos na linha 869) confirmado. A ref. [86] (Katwal et al., ensaios de colunas de betao geopolimerico) esta ligada a taxa alpha=2,9%, nao aos 50 anos, por isso base = premissa_sem_fonte. Os 50 anos sao a vida da estrutura usada na analise de custo de fim de vida comum a HSGC e OPC; aplicam-se tambem ao par 1934 (OPC de referencia, Tab.7).

aplicacao_citacao: Conclusoes (p.14): 'assessing the structural performance of the mixtures would be beneficial to gain a better understanding of their potential application for precast structural members, such as beams and panels' - so como trabalho futuro
nota: Nenhuma mencao a vida util (a unica ocorrencia de 'year' e sobre a geracao anual de residuos). ACV cradle-to-gate de pequena escala. Aplicacao em prefabricados estruturais so referida como potencial futuro, nao declarada.

aplicacao_citacao: Titulo e Sec. 1: 'Precast CSA-based concrete tunnel lining segments reinforced with GFRP bars'; 'the tunnel lining is constructed using precast concrete tunnel lining (PCTL) segments ... placed by the Tunnel Boring Machine'
nota: Aduelas de revestimento de tunel (TBM). Sem numero de anos: so 'during its useful life' (Sec.1) e 'extended service life'; nas conclusoes diz que para tuneis 'the use stage could be considered perpetual'. ACV A1-A4 por aduela (Tab.9).

aplicacao_citacao: Estudo de argamassas geopolimericas FA/GGBFS com escoria de chumbo e fibras PP/PVA em laboratorio (ensaios mecanicos, absorcao, retracao, SEM, ACV); nenhuma aplicacao declarada
nota: Unica mencao: fibras 'contribute to longer service life and reduced maintenance costs' (introducao), sem anos.

aplicacao_citacao: Estudo laboratorial de AANC com nano-GGBFS; so mencoes genericas: 'critical for structural applications such as beams and slabs' (Sec. resistencia a flexao) e 'long-term viability in various infrastructure projects' (Sec. 4.8.4)
nota: Varias mencoes qualitativas a 'extended service life' (resumo, Sec. 4.7.2.2, 4.8.4, conclusoes), nenhuma com numero de anos.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec. 3.2: misturas de referencia (Tab.1, ref.[46]) para avaliar a poupanca de GHG da industria de betao pronto de Hong Kong; FU 1 m3 e por MPa, cradle-to-gate; sem elemento ou obra especifica
nota: Nenhuma mencao a vida util. Ocorrencias de 'year' sao estatisticas anuais de producao/importacao.

aplicacao_citacao: Argamassa geopolimerica de cinza volante com negro de fumo residual, ensaios de laboratorio; conclusoes so falam em 'construction applications' de forma generica
nota: Zero ocorrencias de 'year', 'service life', 'lifespan' ou 'lifetime' no corpo do artigo.

aplicacao_citacao: Titulo e resumo: 'Utilisation of dewatered extracted soil in concrete blocks produced with Portland cement or alkali-activated slag'; blocos de betao comparados com tijolos ceramicos (FCB)
nota: Sem anos de vida util; Sec. LCA so menciona 'terminus of its service life' como fase (fases posteriores ao fabrico nao consideradas, cradle-to-gate).
